title: Insert Interval
summary: Insert a new closed interval into a start-sorted list of disjoint closed intervals.

contractDetails.constraints: 0–10000 existing intervals, already sorted and disjoint. Each pair [start,end] satisfies 0 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ 100000.

statement: Insert a new closed interval into a start-sorted list of disjoint closed intervals. Return the union as disjoint intervals in ascending start order. Intervals sharing an endpoint overlap.

examples.explanation: The first interval shares endpoint 3 with the insertion.
A closed singleton interval is valid.
The insertion bridges all three existing intervals.

constraints: 0–10000 existing intervals, already sorted and disjoint. Each pair [start,end] satisfies 0 ≤ start ≤ end ≤ 100000.
hints: Conceptual: Intervals far from the new interval can be copied directly.
Directional: Partition the scan into intervals before, overlapping, and after the insertion.
Implementation: Merge each overlapping interval into the growing insertion by updating its endpoints.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) extra space excluding the result.
